title: Edmonds matrix
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a commutative semiring, and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix. The associated polynomial matrix has entry $X_{ij}$ when $A_{ij}$ is true and $0$ otherwise, where the variables $X_{ij}$ are indexed by pairs in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}^2$ and the entries are polynomials over $R$.
